esp32-s3-devkitc.reason: CONFIG_FLASH_LOAD_SIZE=0 lets the image slot run to the end of the 8 MB flash that also holds zplc_nvs_partition and storage_partition, so the linker would let an image grow into the stores; the learner board profile owns the bound (IO-009, IO-008)

rpi-pico-rp2040.reason: code_partition of the upstream board covers the whole 2 MB flash, storage_partition included, so the linker would let an image grow into the store; the learner board profile owns the overlay that shrinks it (IO-009, IO-008)

waveshare-rp2040-zero.reason: code_partition of the upstream board covers the whole 2 MB flash, storage_partition included, so the linker would let an image grow into the store; firmware/app/boards/rp2040_zero_rp2040.overlay has to end it at 0x1f0000 (IO-011, IO-008)
